articles.title: Establish 'GST-like' industrial land council for dispute resolution: CII
articles.summary: The Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) has proposed establishing a National Industrial Land Council (NILC), akin to the GST Council, to standardize and harmonize land-related regulations nationwide. This initiative aims to simplify industrial land acquisition, enhance ease of doing business, and boost India's manufacturing competitiveness. For SSB aspirants, this signifies a crucial national economic reform promoting inter-state cooperation and industrial growth.

articles.title: IAF's Garud Special Forces to get compact UAV system with enhanced range, endurance
articles.summary: The Indian government has initiated the procurement of a compact unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) system for the Indian Air Force's elite Special Forces unit. These advanced UAVs are designed to operate effectively in extreme environments, enhancing reconnaissance and operational capabilities for critical missions. This move aims to bolster the Special Forces' effectiveness and modernise their surveillance assets.

articles.title: 22k gold rate today on Akshaya Tritiya 2026: Check 24k, 22k, 18k gold prices (April 19, 2026) in New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and other cities
articles.summary: Akshaya Tritiya, an annual spring festival celebrated by Hindus and Jains, is deemed one of the most auspicious days for new beginnings and significant purchases, especially gold. Believers hold that any positive action or investment made on this day brings enduring success, prosperity, and good fortune, making it a culturally significant occasion for economic and personal growth.

articles.title: Defence stocks breakout: Should you book profits or buy the dip? Anand James answers
articles.summary: Indian defence stocks are surging with double-digit gains, attracting significant investor attention. This robust performance signals growing confidence in the domestic defence industry, likely driven by 'Make in India' initiatives and increased indigenous procurement. While indicating a strengthening sector vital for national security, some stocks are flashing 'overbought' signals, suggesting a need for careful analysis.

articles.title: India must remain ready for West Asia fallout, says Rajnath Singh
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh emphasized India's need to be prepared for any sudden escalation in the volatile West Asia conflict. He stressed the region's instability, urging India to remain vigilant and ready to adapt to evolving geopolitical challenges. This highlights the importance of strategic foresight and robust national defence planning to safeguard India's interests amidst global uncertainties.
